title: Treasure Hunt
story:
[BONUS MISSION - PART 1]
Someone buried a `CYBERUS{...}` flag deep inside `~/treasure/` among hidden dot-directories and a 1,000-line log file (`ancient.log`). Dig it out!
objective:
1. Explore `~/treasure/` using `tree -a` or `ls -la` to locate the hidden `ancient.log` file.
2. Open `ancient.log` with `less` (and search with `/CYBERUS`), `head`, or `tail` to find the flag.
3. Submit the flag with `quest submit CYBERUS{...}`.
hints: Hidden folders and files start with `.`. Run `tree -a ~/treasure` to see the entire structure at once.
Open the 1,000-line file with `less`, type `/CYBERUS`, and press Enter.
Once you find `CYBERUS{...}`, exit `less` with `q` and run `quest submit CYBERUS{...}`.
